extracted.intended_audience: Prospective applicants to the Office of Naval Research (universities, nonprofits, commercial entities, and contractors seeking ONR grants or contracts)
extracted.subtask_short: applying for ONR grants and contracts
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and submitting proposals or applications to the Office of Naval Research, including pre-award credentials, eligibility, and compliance expectations. Covers both contract proposals and grant applications and points applicants to announcement-specific instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand ONR's policies on conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Before you submit a proposal for an ONR award, make sure you understand ONR's policies on conflicts of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must be aware of ONR conflict-of-interest requirements prior to submission. See ONR policies (linked) for definitions, disclosure obligations, and restrictions; this helps avoid disqualification or later compliance issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obtain required business credentials
rubrics_metrics.description: Before you can do business with the Office of Naval Research, Department of Navy, Department of Defense and other federal agencies, you may need to obtain certain credentials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective applicants should obtain any agency-required registrations/credentials (e.g., SAM, DUNS/CAGE historically, and other DoD/DoN credentials) before submitting proposals or accepting awards. Check agency guidance for the specific credentials required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow instructions to submit a proposal for a research contract
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a Proposal for a Research Contract — Learn how to submit a winning proposal to the Office of Naval Research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use ONR-provided guidance pages and the specific Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) or solicitation instructions for proposal content, formatting, submission method, and evaluation criteria. 'Winning' proposals conform to solicitation requirements and address evaluation factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for grant applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit an Application for a Grant — Universities, nonprofits and commercial entities may submit grant proposals to enter into a contractual relationship with the Office of Naval Research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm organizational eligibility (university, nonprofit, commercial entity, etc.) before applying. Follow the NOFO/BAA eligibility language and any restrictions on types of organizations or partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with human subjects research regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: Compliance and Protections — ONR helps ensure human subject research supported by the Department of Navy complies with federal regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If proposed work involves human subjects, ensure proposals include appropriate protections, IRB approvals or plans, and compliance with applicable federal human subjects regulations; follow ONR and DoN requirements for documentation and review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational conflicts of interest protections
rubrics_metrics.description: Compliance and Protections — Learn how ONR protects against organizational conflicts of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be prepared to identify and mitigate organizational conflicts of interest per ONR/DoD policies. Include necessary disclosures and mitigation plans as required by the solicitation or agency rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use solicitation-specific contact and procedural instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: For inquiries regarding contracts and grants, please refer to the specific Broad Agency Announcement (BAA), BAA Call or Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) for POC information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All procedural questions, submission deadlines, and point-of-contact details are handled at the solicitation level; applicants should rely on the specific BAA/BAA Call/NOFO text rather than general pages for binding instructions and timelines.
